name: 1337-fixedlen-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 20% and cooldown 10% both mode=requests, bounded at 2000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text: 2000 requests, exactly 128 prompt tokens in and exactly 256 tokens out on every one (min = max on both); n=1, temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, ignore_eos true, no penalties, no logprobs, max_tokens 256, sent as plain completions rather than through a chat template.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter text completion service generating fixed 256-token replies to short prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.1-12-gaa9af07cac (late October 2023) AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at
# engine construction. Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- there is no chunked prefill, no prefix
# caching, no enforce_eager, no max_seq_len_to_capture, no kv-cache-dtype and no V1 engine here.
# `max-paddings` does exist at this commit, but not in a September 2023 one.

model: huggyllama/llama-7b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: half
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
max-paddings: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
